candidate.selection_reason: observable input/src -> Function constructor call -> arbitrary code execution vulnerability

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment. Common in: input_validation.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting
